versions.changelog:
Initial release: Provides workflow helper for adapting PollyReach-style productivity patterns based on validated high demand.

- Assists users in creating, improving, or debugging PollyReach-style workflows.
- Generates local-hardware friendly checklists, code, or templates to reduce manual work.
- Ensures outputs are tailored, reusable, and verifiable against user-defined success criteria.
- Offers clear triggers and instructions to support diverse productivity and workflow needs.
